sql: SELECT coalesce(e.parent_outcome,'-') AS parent_did, count(*) AS twin_opened, count(p.id) FILTER (WHERE p.status='settled') AS settled, count(p.id) FILTER (WHERE p.status='settled' AND p.pnl>0) AS wins, sum(p.quantity) FILTER (WHERE p.status='settled') AS contracts, round(sum(p.pnl) FILTER (WHERE p.status='settled')::numeric,4) AS twin_pnl_usd, round((100*sum(p.pnl) FILTER (WHERE p.status='settled')/nullif(sum(p.quantity) FILTER (WHERE p.status='settled'),0))::numeric,3) AS cents_per_ct FROM live_paper_parity_events e LEFT JOIN paper_positions p ON p.market_ticker=e.market_ticker AND p.strategy=e.twin_tag WHERE e.twin_tag='Fmmsell10_pt4' AND e.twin_outcome='opened' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY twin_opened DESC
